assets.summary: WebSocket auto-reconnect with exponential backoff and jitter
strategy: Listen for WebSocket close events to detect disconnection
Implement exponential backoff algorithm (base delay 1s, max delay 30s)
Add random jitter of ±20% to prevent thundering herd problem
Set maximum retry count to 10 attempts
Reset retry counter on successful connection
Trigger error callback after exceeding max retries
Optionally implement heartbeat detection for dead connections
